## New in 0.1.11

- **Calendar year view.** All twelve months fit in the available space. Scroll to move between
  years, see which days contain tasks, and open a month or day from the overview.
- **Create tasks inside the calendar.** The + button and a click on empty space in a month
  cell open the full task editor with the date and list filled from the calendar context. Add notes,
  priority, tags and attachments before saving, without leaving the calendar.
- **Portable profiles.** Place an empty `.portable` file beside the executable, or beside
  the `.AppImage` on Linux, to keep data in a nearby `Data` folder. On macOS, put the marker
  beside `Fern.app`. Existing profiles
  stay separate; use Backup & Restore to move your data. ([#8](https://github.com/atabits/fern/issues/8))
- **Drop files and folders onto tasks.** Files become attachments; folders are packed into
  ZIP archives. Attachments use the same 32 MiB limit locally and on the sync server.
  ([#9](https://github.com/atabits/fern/issues/9))
- **Optional Windows notification area behavior.** Enable the setting to keep Fern in the
  notification area when minimizing its window. It is off by default.
  ([#11](https://github.com/atabits/fern/issues/11))
- **Date and holiday options.** Choose Google Calendar or Apple iCloud for Chinese holidays,
  use the `2026-12-31` date format, and select a year, month and day in the countdown date picker.
  ([#14](https://github.com/atabits/fern/issues/14))
- **Sticky note controls.** Choose a note color and use its task menus in compact windows.
  On Windows, pin the note above other windows. Double-click the header to collapse or expand it.
- **Release notes in the app.** Read the changes before installing an update and after the
  updated app starts.

## Bug fixes

- **Calendar subscription time zones.** Events with an IANA `TZID` now use the correct local
  time. For example, a New York event at 09:00 on November 15, 2026 and its 14:00 UTC equivalent
  both appear at 17:00 in Moscow. Repeats are calculated in the source zone, including daylight
  saving changes, exclusions and moved instances. All-day dates stay on their intended day.
  Unsupported time zones are reported in Integrations instead of silently treated as local time.
- **Long text fields.** Long titles stay inside their input fields and scroll with the cursor.
  Selection, mouse input and IME keep the correct position. Saved titles are not shortened.
  ([#15](https://github.com/atabits/fern/issues/15))
- **Scrolling in short windows.** Focus statistics, settings and navigation remain reachable;
  content no longer runs underneath the settings header. Switching settings sections starts
  at the top. ([#10](https://github.com/atabits/fern/issues/10),
  [#12](https://github.com/atabits/fern/issues/12))
- **Buttons and menus.** Calendar controls, task tags and matrix header actions now respond;
  unavailable controls have been removed. The calendar view menu keeps a stable width and
  opens its submenu only when needed. ([#13](https://github.com/atabits/fern/issues/13))
- **Keyboard focus.** Escape closes menus and popups and returns focus to the editor or list.
  It no longer minimizes the main window. Tag selection filters existing tags and applies
  changes on confirmation.
- **Task creation.** Matrix quick-add handles deleted or archived default lists. Task fields
  are saved together, and retrying after an attachment error no longer creates duplicate tasks.
  Attachment transfer failures are shown instead of reporting a fully successful sync.
- **Sticky note windows.** Opening a submenu or resizing a note no longer causes flicker or
  clipped menus. Switching to another application closes the menu without removing the note.
- **Task details and habits.** Note paragraph spacing stays consistent while editing. Deleted
  tasks no longer leave stale details open, and the weekly habit summary stays in the active
  view rather than appearing in the archive.
